resources.string: SONIQ needs Bluetooth Scan and Connect access to discover earbuds, headphones, and speakers, read live battery and codec telemetry, and manage connections. All data stays on your device.
Coarse location is optional and used only when you choose to record Last-Known Disconnect Location for Find Device (or for BLE scanning on Android 11 and older).
Notification permission lets SONIQ alert you when connected audio hardware drops below your battery threshold or changes connection state.
